title: 第17章 记下了炼完你我就去杀它第18章 金色词条启程苍云岭
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
lines: “你......你做了什么？”
血妖怕了，它的声音第一次带上了慌乱。
陆渊没有回答，只是催动着开天之力充斥在四肢百骸，以摧枯拉朽之势席卷全身。
所过之处，血妖本源像是烈焰中的积雪，瞬间消融瓦解。
其中蕴含的血妖意志就像是泡沫一样破碎消散，污秽气息也像烟雾一样蒸发无踪。
剩下的，就只有最纯净的本源。
万化无极功运转，本源之力从四肢百骸涌入经脉之中，被吞噬，吸收，炼化。
那张血脸彻底扭曲了。
它感觉到了自己正在被一点一点的炼化。
它发出撕心裂肺的尖叫，试图逃离，然而这片血海已经脱离了他的掌控。
“你到底是什么东西？为什么没有被侵蚀？”
它声音颤抖，其中透出难掩的恐惧。
陆渊没有回答，那股破灭一切的力量从他体内轰然爆发，向着四周席卷而去。
所过之处，剧烈翻涌的血海瞬间瓦解成大片血雾。
血雾升腾，又被一股无形力量牵引，鲸吞一般被陆渊纳入体内。
“我的本源！我的修为！”
“饶命！大人饶命——”
陆渊面无表情，继续运功。
血妖哀求无果，声音陡然尖锐刺耳。
“你不能杀我！我大兄是苍云岭尸魔！”
“我若死了，它一定会找你报仇，将你炼成尸傀，让你求生不得求死不能！”
陆渊脸上闪过一抹凝重，“好，记下了，炼完你我就去杀它。”
血妖彻底绝望了。
它发出凄厉哀嚎，声音越来越弱，最后消散在雾气之中。
【击杀初境血妖，获得绿色词条[燃血]】
陆渊闭眼内视，催动万化无极功，将血妖本源化作灵力引入十二正经与奇经八脉。
血雾开始肉眼可见地变稀薄，而他周身气息则是迅速攀升。
初境一层。
初境二层。
初境三层。
一个时辰后，陆渊的气息逐渐稳定。
content_en:
"You...what did you do?"
The blood demon was scared, and its voice sounded panicked for the first time.
Lu Yuan did not answer, but just urged the power of opening the sky to fill his limbs and bones, sweeping through his whole body with a devastating force.
Wherever it passes, the origin of the blood demon melts and disintegrates instantly like snow in the flames.
The blood demon's will contained in it shattered and dissipated like a bubble, and the filthy breath evaporated without a trace like smoke.
All that is left is the purest source.
The Wanhua Wuji Gong is operating, and the original power pours into the meridians from the limbs and bones, and is swallowed, absorbed, and refined.
The bloody face was completely distorted.
It felt like it was being refined bit by bit.
"No-"
It let out a heart-rending scream and tried to escape, but the sea of blood was no longer under his control.
"Who are you? Why haven't you been eroded?"
Its voice trembled, and there was unconcealed fear in it.
Lu Yuan did not answer, and the power that destroyed everything burst out from his body and swept away around him.
Wherever it passed, the violently surging sea of ​​blood instantly disintegrated into a large mass of blood mist.
The blood mist rose and was pulled by an invisible force, swallowed by Lu Yuan like a whale.
"No-"
"My origin! My cultivation!"
"Spare your life! My lord, spare your life—"
Lu Yuan had no expression on his face and continued to practice his skills.
The blood demon begged to no avail, and his voice suddenly became sharp and harsh.
"You can't kill me! My eldest brother is the Cangyunling Corpse Demon!"
"If I die, it will definitely seek revenge on you and turn you into a corpse puppet, so that you can neither survive nor die!"
A look of solemnity flashed across Lu Yuan's face, "Okay, I'll remember it. I'll kill it after I finish training you."
"You!"
The blood demon was completely desperate.
"You're crazy...you're crazy..."
It let out a shrill wail, its sound getting weaker and weaker, and finally dissipated in the mist.
[Kill the first-level blood demon and obtain the green entry [Burning Blood]]
Lu Yuan closed his eyes and looked inside, activated the Wanhua Wuji Gong, and transformed the origin of the blood demon into spiritual power and introduced it into the twelve main meridians and the eight extraordinary meridians.
The blood mist began to thin visibly to the naked eye, while the aura around him rose rapidly.
First level.
The second level of the initial realm.
The third level of the initial realm.
An hour later, Lu Yuan's aura gradually stabilized.
title_en: Chapter 17: Remember that I will kill it after refining you Chapter 18: The golden entry sets off for Cangyun Ridge
